FORM CONTRACT FOR ELECTRIC SERVICE – LARGE LOAD




                          SOAH ORDER NO. 10
                     EXTENDING BRIEFING DEADLINES

      On August 27, 2026, the Southwestern Electric Power Company, on behalf
of all parties to the proceeding, filed an agreed motion to extend the briefing
deadlines in order to allow the parties additional time to negotiate a potential
settlement. The motion is GRANTED, and the briefing deadlines are revised as
follows:
            Initial briefs:   September 3, 2026
            Reply briefs:     September 11, 2026
 Signed August 27, 2026


                                       ALJ Signature(s):


                                       _____________________________
                                       Daniel Wiseman,
                                       Presiding Administrative Law Judge
